resources.string: Stops uploads and scanning, removes the saved sign-in and cached storage inventory. Your local files and Google Photos library stay in place.

Photos Unlimited %1$s

Independent Android uploader. Not affiliated with Google.

Turn off backup in the official Google Photos app when this app handles uploads. Original files stay on your phone. Upload acceptance is not proof of storage exemption. Existing library items keep their accounting unless you replace them with Free up storage.

Storage scans read Google Photos metadata; Drive and Gmail are not included. Missing accounting is shown as unknown. Free up storage deletes the items you choose from Google Photos only after a byte-identical copy is saved on this phone, then uploads that copy again.

Protocol adapted from xob0t’s GPMC and gotohp.
